title: 第一卷 第15章 墨如烟的不同寻常第一卷 第16章 叶云你不想摸一下
slug: 人在废丹房从征服师姐开始成仙
content_zh:
;;
顷刻之间，一道青光飞掠而出，径直向叶云袭来。
“师姐饶命，误会啊！”
叶云赶忙开口，双手都举了起来。
转眼间，池水中的女子已到近前，身上则裹着一件白色的浴巾。
对方傲人的曲线，在这浴巾的包裹之下尽显无疑。
从脸颊流淌而下的水珠，划过脖子，穿过锁骨，落入长长的事业线。
尽管这出浴美人看着无比香艳，可叶云心中，却是没什么欣赏的心情。
只因在自己脖子前，正悬着一柄长剑，剑尖几乎就抵在他的喉咙之上，再稍稍往前他小命就没了。
“师姐，我是来找人，走错路才不小心到这来。”
面对叶云的解释，女修冷冷看着他道。
“这么大的玉女峰，偏偏走错到沐浴之处，你觉得我信吗？”
事实上，以前就没少有人在偷窥时用这个理由。
也就像叶云先前所想，这种事情，确实是跳进黄河洗不清。
可即使如此，叶云也必须得解释。
“真的，我是来找墨如烟，墨师姐，您看，这还有她的信物！”
他当即将东西拿出来，给对面的女修看了一眼。
只希望以此，来证明自己不是为偷窥人洗澡而来。
见到他手中东西，女修神色淡漠，只缓缓说了一句。
“我就是你要找的墨如烟。”

“……”
此话一出，叶云心里咯噔一声。
坏咯，这不尴尬了吗？
没办法，他只能暗骂自己的手，刚才瞎指什么，给指到这边来了。
更让他哭笑不得，是这时耳边还传来造化神炉的声音。
【检测到墨如烟身上存在造化点，请想办法将之获取！】
从对方身上获取造化点，那自己可真是疯了。
现在这情况，自己有半点说错，保不齐真会被打断三条腿……
“咳咳，那可真是太巧了。”
叶云也只能尴尬地挠了挠头。
好在确定身份后，墨如烟倒是将飞剑收了起来，并打量了叶云一眼。
随后，她淡淡问道：“你就是，雪岚师妹提到的叶云？”
叶云当即行了一礼，恭敬地道。
“正是在下，看来师姐已经跟您说过了。”

In an instant, a ray of green light flew out and struck directly at Ye Yun.
"Sister, please forgive me, it's a misunderstanding!"
Ye Yun hurriedly spoke, raising both hands.
In the blink of an eye, the woman in the pool was approaching, wrapped in a white bath towel.
The other party's proud curves were clearly displayed under the towel.
The water droplets flowing down from the cheeks crossed the neck, passed through the collarbone, and fell into the long career line.
Although this bathing beauty looked extremely fragrant, Ye Yun didn't feel much appreciation in his heart.
Just because there was a long sword hanging in front of his neck, and the tip of the sword was almost touching his throat. If he moved a little further, his life would be dead.
"Senior sister, I came here to find someone, and I accidentally ended up here because I took the wrong path."
Facing Ye Yun's explanation, the female cultivator looked at him coldly and said.
"Such a huge Jade Girl Peak, but you went to the wrong bathing place. Do you think I believe it?"
In fact, many people used this reason when peeping in the past.
Just as Ye Yun thought before, this kind of thing cannot be washed away by jumping into the Yellow River.
But even so, Ye Yun still had to explain.
"Really, I'm here to see Mo Ruyan, Senior Sister Mo, look, here's her token!"
He immediately took out the things and took a look at the female cultivator opposite.
I just hope to use this to prove that I am not here to bathe for peeping people.
Seeing the thing in his hand, the female cultivator looked indifferent and only said slowly.
"I am the Mo Ruyan you are looking for."
"..."
As soon as these words came out, Ye Yun's heart skipped a beat.
Damn it, isn’t this embarrassing?
He had no choice but to curse his hands secretly for pointing to something blindly just now.
What made him even more dumbfounded was that the sound of the Divine Furnace of Creation could still be heard in his ears.
[It has been detected that there is a creation point on Mo Ruyan, please find a way to get it! 】
If you get fortune points from the other party, then you are really crazy.
In this situation, I was slightly wrong. If I didn't keep it all right, my three legs would be broken...
"Ahem, that's such a coincidence."
Ye Yun could only scratch his head in embarrassment.
Fortunately, after confirming his identity, Mo Ruyan put away the flying sword and looked at Ye Yun.
Then, she asked calmly: "Are you the Ye Yun that Junior Sister Xue Lan mentioned?"
Ye Yun immediately bowed and said respectfully.
"Exactly, it seems that Senior Sister has already told you."
